## Notes for Next Session

- **The build scripts lived in the session scratchpad and are gone.** Recipe (device-builds.md): sync worktrees `./tools/fork-worktree sync` (refuse if a `rocknix-build` container is up; discard the build-written doc under `documentation/` first), verify worktree HEAD == `next`, then `DOCKER_EXTRA_OPTS="-v /workspace/repos/rocknix/.git:/workspace/repos/rocknix/.git -v /workspace/cache/rocknix-sources:$D/sources" make docker-H700` from `/workspace/repos/rocknix.worktrees/devices` (x64 from `…/generic-x64`, `make docker-GENERIC_X64`). Warm rebuilds take ~2–3 min (ccache); judge by stamps/objects, not duration. Copy `target/*.tar` (+`.img.gz`) into a dated artefact dir with `sha256sum` before the next build overwrites `target/`.
- **Deploy**: idle check (emulator, `rclon[e]`, `flock -n /var/run/cloud_sync.lock true`, `~/.update` empty) → scp to a staging dir → device-side `sha256sum` → `mv` into `~/.update` → `systemctl reboot` — **only with the maintainer's yes for that build** (D-QA-008/011).
- **VM pair**: guest a `-p 10022` (image `61ae10975f`), guest b `-p 10023` (`748ffd41b8`, QA scratch under `/storage/roms/{gba,snes,nes,pico-8}`, CONTENT_REMOTE `/rocknix-qa/CONTENT`); key `/tmp/rocknix-vm-pair/qa-key`; monitors `/tmp/rocknix-qemu-monitor{,-b}.sock`; MinIO on :9010 (`CLOUD_QA_BACKEND=s3 tools/cloud-test-backend rclone-conf|saves-remote|content-remote`). **Both guests still share device id `GENERICX64-15ca35b6b4`** until the pair is re-created with the new `--mac` (#91) — do that before any two-device fixture. `/tmp` on the host may be wiped by a reboot (pair sockets, key).
- **Gotchas paid for this session**: `git cherry-pick` has no `-q`; a stopped rebase is detected by `test -d "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)/rebase-merge"`, not by grepping output; never `cd /workspace/repos/rocknix` and then commit the session-state file (lands on `next`'s stale copy); ES `xgettext` fails the image on a non-ASCII comment before `_( )`; read boot order in monotonic time; a workflow agent asked to "wait" may arm a monitor and return early — say "synchronous Bash loop"; `pkill -f` on your own pattern kills your shell (exit 144); a null `agent()` result may hide finished work (read `agent-<id>.jsonl`).
- **Capture facts for the device read**: `last-capture` = `<epoch> <cloud_capture rc> <mode> <unit> emu-exit=<N|?> <emulator>/<core>`; a member with no entry is recorded only if mtime ≥ session start (`--started`); thumbnails are members without entries; `--full` runs detached at boot when a cloud-saves toggle is on.
